- kurtosis: mean -0.1485, std 0.4654, trend -0.0238 (slightly decreasing)
- trend_slope: mean 0.0731, std 1.3392, trend -0.0621

- tau_ac1: mean -0.0061, std 0.3427, trend 0.0071

The ac1 trend of 0.2757 is quite strong - increasing autocorrelation is a classic early warning signal of approaching a tipping point. Low frequency power is also increasing (trend 0.2016), which is another early warning signal (critical slowing down).
